fieldNotes.location: Supplied coords (movedMeters 2662) landed in the Cardinal Commerce Center area but not exactly on the building. Resolved via web research: PFG occupies Phase I-Building B of Cardinal Commerce Center, a 420,000 SF building (PFG leases 332,000 SF) at 10399 Washington Highway, Hanover County. The building was positively ID'd in March 2026 Street View — a red 'Performance Foodservice' wall logo faces the fenced front employee lot. Locked center: 37.69430, -77.46680.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate across a lane, or guard booth visible at the truck court entrance or at the two front employee-lot driveway openings. The front employee parking lot is enclosed by a black ornamental security fence, but the driveway openings are uncontrolled curb cuts. The truck court is open paved area on a loop road. Because no gate is confirmed across any lane, truckGate is false — flagged given the perimeter fencing could imply a gate not resolvable in imagery.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No small staffed-booth structure visible at any entrance in satellite or Street View. As a brand-new (2023) build the site may have a kiosk, but no booth — false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because no truck gate is confirmed; if a gate exists, the absence of a booth would make this true. Flagged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: A very large 420,000 SF DC. The southwest face carries a long dock line; estimated ~70 doors total. Banded 50+; construction materials in the truck court and roof glare make this an estimate.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: The building has a loop road around it with the truck court on the southwest and separate north/east access — distinct in and out routing is likely. Medium confidence.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Brand-new build with a wide truck court and generous paved aprons — physical room for an express/bypass lane. Inferred — flagged.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Cardinal Commerce Center, southern Hanover County near Virginia Center Commons / Glen Allen — within the Richmond metro's developing northern fabric, with residential subdivisions immediately adjacent. Urban.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur enters the property — railServed false.
fieldNotes.multiStep: No second checkpoint stage observed; false.
fieldNotes.general: Imagery shows the site mid-finish-out (2024-2026 captures): construction barriers/materials still staged in the truck yard. Counts are honest estimates.
